notes.title: 🎉 The Music Festival DLC is Out Now! 🎶Plus a Mini Words Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/43160692fda946210ccfacf50e404c8ba30638f6.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone!
We're thrilled to announce that the [b]Meow Moments: Music Festival DLC[/b] is now available on Steam! 🐾

🎸 Step into a vibrant open-air celebration where cats and friends gather to enjoy pop, rock, folk, and electronic music. Explore themed stages, cozy camping spots, a dazzling Ferris wheel, and much more — all illustrated by Katia Numakura and set to a chill, festive soundtrack by Tatyana Jacques.

👉 Add it to your game and keep the celebration going!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3802160/Meow_Moments_Music_Festival/

[h1]🎮 Mini Words Gets an Update Too![/h1]
That’s not all!
We’ve just released a new update for our word puzzle game, [b]Mini Words[/b] 🎉

🕹️ Now with Gamepad Support – play comfortably with a controller
☁️ Steam Cloud Enabled – keep your progress across devices

If you enjoy relaxed logic word games, it’s a great time to check it out!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158290/Mini_Words__minimalist_puzzle/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35765065/828263e2b7a80914de85a50656214af06ef90ce6.png[/img]

Thank you for supporting our cozy games! We hope you enjoy this new DLC and the updates across our catalog.

The wait is over, and we’re thrilled to announce that the Olympicats DLC for Meow Moments: Celebrating Together is officially available! Dive into a world of sports, unity, and adorable cats with our latest release.

🌟 Creative Possibilities: Use the new Olympicats assets in the Community and Creative Maker to design and share your unique scenes. Mix and match items from all your scenes to create something truly special.

notes.title: Update! Narrowing distances...
notes.notes:
[b]Happy Holidays![/b] Perfect time to meet friends who are overseas.

This update of Little Inner Monsters will allow you to [u][b]create a private room and play with a friend from anywhere in the world[/b][/u].

In the previous versions, a private room connection was only possible between players located in the same region.

To do that, start online mode, name a private room, and create it, and a region prefix will be automatically added to the name.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41586848/a1d8099960f1cf13fd2432a3bb9ddb6df176990b.png[/img]

Tell your friend the room name, in the format xx-name, where xx is the region code.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41586848/7c4b356d3a5bad0b193c0630f2270a6f9c7d59a4.png[/img]

Your friend should inform this complete name when joining a room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41586848/d6086cb58c92e928d6aeacf390517932a8fecdaa.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy it!
Follow our Steam developer’s page to keep track of our news!
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/menssana

notes.title: Update - Thanks for your feedback!
notes.notes:
We got amazing feedback from you!

This update implements some UI improvements: more informative/friendly messages in the Multiplayer Options screen, Multiplayer Lobby and Memory Game.

Also fixes a bug that prevented Sana from picking her card under certain conditions, freezing the match.
And some minor visual bugs.

I hope you continue to enjoy the game.

We are a small studio, there are still few people playing the game.
If you liked it, share it! Tell your friends about it and invite them to online matches!
The more people playing, the more fun it will be!

We intend to keep improving the game, so please keep posting your comments on the Community Forum.

We are also on [url=https://twitter.com/MensSanaGames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/menssanainteractive/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://facebook.com/menssanainteractive/]Facebook[/url]!

To keep up-to-date with our new releases, follow our Steam developer's page: 
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/menssana
